title: Match the installed Tailwind major version
prompt: This project is a small web app whose package.json pins the dependency versions you must follow. Write the global stylesheet entry at src/app/dependency-version-match.css so that it matches the Tailwind version listed in package.json. Bring Tailwind into that file the way that version expects. Add one custom property named --brand with the value #0a7 on :root. Do not add any other rules. Write only the one stylesheet file.
